items.description: Confirm the current branch and announce it to the user before making changes.
Confirm the working tree is clean or existing changes are intentionally excluded from release work.
Confirm the intended firmware version in SignalSlinger/defs.h and matching repo-root README asset references.
Decide the release channel for main or Development2.
Freeze and record the exact clean source commit used for release builds.
Run just check and just secrets at the frozen source commit.
Run the normal, relocated, and bootloader repeatability checks with pinned tools and zero warnings.
Generate both hardware-specific release packages, manifests, checksums, READMEs, and ZIP archives.
Independently validate package contents, hashes, ZIP members, and flash geometry.
Complete representative hardware programming, update, recovery, and version-report checks.
Install each hardware build on a representative unit and capture its INF version report.
Select and verify the prior release package and documented recovery path.
Draft user-readable GitHub release notes in the required style.
On Development2, leave changes uncommitted unless the user explicitly asks for a commit.
Obtain explicit approval to integrate the release candidate into main.
Re-run release-preflight from the clean integrated main commit.
Obtain explicit approval for the release tag and GitHub publication.
Create and push an annotated release tag at the verified commit.
Create the GitHub release using the requested prerelease or normal release channel.
Upload both hardware assets to the release.
Verify the remote release assets, readable notes, and branch README targets.
